definition: Stable unique identifier for each analytical water-system case.
notes: Use for joins rather than system name.

definition: Human-readable name of the utility/system used as the analytical case.
Standardized primary source category for the analytical case.
notes: Core analytical field; preserves meaningful source distinctions.

definition: Specific source or source-system description.
notes: Contextual metadata; not the standardized category.

definition: Best available measure of typical existing water-system use for the relevant scope.
notes: Core analytical field. Do not substitute broader-system figures for missing plant/district values.

definition: Reference year for average daily water-use observation.
notes: Year belongs to the metric, not necessarily the whole row.

definition: Whether average daily water use is directly reported or calculated.
notes: Modeled values should be added later as a separate analytical layer.

definition: Availability/quality status for average daily water use.
Source ID supporting the water-use value/status.
Rated/approved/design/peak treatment capacity for the relevant system or plant.
notes: Core analytical field; interpret with capacity_type.

definition: Reference year for treatment-capacity observation.
Original/standardized meaning of the capacity figure.
allowed_values: treatment_capacity | approved_treatment_capacity | rated_treatment_capacity | design_treatment_capacity | peak_treatment_capacity | not_applicable_distribution_system
notes: Do not relabel unlike capacity concepts.

definition: Availability/timeliness status for treatment capacity.
Source ID supporting treatment capacity.
Numeric population/customer scale served by the system.
notes: Core contextual field; compare only alongside served_unit.

definition: Unit represented by served_value.
notes: People and accounts are not directly comparable.

definition: Qualifier attached to served_value.
notes: Preserves ~ and > without storing them in numeric fields.

definition: Reference year for served_value.
Source ID supporting served value.
Scope represented by the row and its core metrics.
notes: Important for distinguishing treatment plants, distribution PWSs, and regional/system cases.

definition: Compact status flag for remaining core-data gaps.
notes: Project-management field, not an analytical outcome.

definition: Important interpretation, caveats, derivations, and contextual facts retained from research.
notes: Raw MD remains the authoritative full research record.
